notes: The game now tells you when a new version is ready. Tap UPDATE on the menu: your progress is kept.
AUTOPILOT badges fly your plane perfectly for 8 seconds: nothing can crash you!
Grab the green SAF can for cleaner fuel: less CO2 and thinner contrails.
A forest meter at the bottom grows as your trees soak up CO2. Plant early!
Sunset and sunrise are slower, and a little dial under the distance shows when night is coming.
No more soil patches once your parcels are gone.
